# Mapping Africa — 2020

> Benchmark chips for Africa (Mapping Africa sites) cut from the 2020 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection lacuna.

- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/lacuna_2020_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/lacuna_2020_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/lacuna_2020_fields.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2020/items.parquet)
